description: End-to-end bootstrap for a command-line tool repository — a native, agent-friendly CLI in Rust (clap, optional Ratatui terminal UI), Go (Cobra, optional Bubble Tea terminal UI), Swift (swift-argument-parser) or C#/.NET 10 (System.CommandLine + Spectre.Console, Native AOT, optional full-screen terminal UI) — that follows one contract across languages: data on stdout and messages on stderr, a documented exit-code taxonomy (0–7, 130/143), `--format text|json|jsonl` with a JSON error envelope, TTY/`NO_COLOR`-aware colour, no prompts without a terminal (`--no-input`/`--yes`), `--dry-run` for mutations, `completion`/`schema` commands and a CLI reference generated from the command tree. Collects `language` (`rust`/`go`/`swift`/`dotnet`), `ui` (`none`/`tui`; not offered for Swift), `accessibility` (`enforce`/`report`/`off` — only with `ui: tui`: the level of the terminal UI's asserted accessibility checks, written by the scaffold to `.ui-quality.yml`), `branching` (`gitflow`/`main-only`), the tool's identity (`bin-name`, `description`, license, developer name/email/organization URL, `owner`) and the shared pipeline parameters (integration branch `develop`, stable branch `main`, `open-source`, repository `visibility` (detected via `gh repo view` or asked), `ci`, `cross-os-ci` (when the ~10×-cost macOS and ~1.7×-cost Windows test legs run: `all`/`stable`), `ci-tests`, `pages`, `distribution` (`none` / `internal` = native binaries + SHA256SUMS + build-provenance attestations on GitHub Releases / `store` = also package channels such as crates.io, Homebrew, Scoop, WinGet or a NuGet .NET tool), `channels`, `sonar` plus its detail keys — each question stating the Actions-minutes / runner-multiplier / SonarCloud / Pages cost facts for that visibility) once, prints a setup-mode statement (from scratch, or an inventory of the prior setup it found), then orchestrates the language's scaffold (`iru-setup-rust-cli`, `iru-setup-go-cli`, `iru-setup-swift-cli`, or `iru-setup-dotnet-cli`) → `iru-setup-antora` → the language's gitignore skill (`iru-setup-rust-gitignore`, `iru-setup-go-gitignore`, `iru-setup-swift-gitignore` with `flavor: cli`, or `iru-setup-dotnet-gitignore`) → `iru-setup-cli-github-workflows` → `iru-setup-changelog` → `iru-setup-readme`, in that order, via `iru-isolated-skill-executor`, so nothing is asked twice — skipping the workflows step entirely (security block included) when `ci: no`. Invoke as `/iru-setup-cli-repository`, optionally with `args` (`key: value` lines) to pre-resolve `language`, `ui`, `accessibility`, `branching`, `mode` (`new`/`existing`), `open-source`, `visibility`, `ci`, `cross-os-ci`, `ci-tests`, `pages`, `distribution`, `channels`, `homebrew-tap`, `on-existing` (`ask`/`keep`/`update`/`replace`, forwarded only when supplied), `sonar` (+ `sonar-organization`/`sonar-project-key`/`sonar-host-url`), `integration-branch`, `stable-branch`, and every identity field, skipping the matching question. On an existing repository every component sub-skill warns about the prior setup it owns and asks Update / Keep as is / Replace per file (unless `on-existing` decides), and the final report states the action taken per component. Use whenever bootstrapping (or catching up) a CLI tool repository's full skeleton/docs/gitignore/CI/release/changelog/README scaffold in one pass.
